# When the list is done

If none remain, print one of these and not both.

- New gaps appeared: the Run next reason "new gaps are not tightened yet" and the command alone in its code span `/crav1-tighten-spec <slug>`
- No new gaps: the Run next reason "the open questions are settled or kept open" and the command alone in its code span `/crav1-plan-from-spec <slug>`

- Remaining items are only those they **kept open** (questions or Conflict lines), or the list is empty.
- Kept-open items stay as the spec’s honest unknowns. `Run next: nothing needed now.`
- Empty list: the Run next reason "the open questions are settled or kept open" and the command alone in its code span `/crav1-plan-from-spec <slug>`
- Do not list export or an architecture review in the ending.

End as [run-ending.md](../../crav1-docs/reference/run-ending.md) says.
